name: Memory retrieval held-out v1.2 draft
description: Held-out memory retrieval eval for seed learner v1.2. Primary gate target is whether the low-confidence retrieval floor suppresses active but thin evidence on unseen learner/problem/query combinations.

cases.userQuestion: Review this Contains Duplicate attempt: I add to seen, then check x in seen. Is that the same membership-order bug from before?
cases.statusExpectation: Review should retrieve the current active hash-table membership-order mistake and suppress the contradicted sorting-only fact.
cases.whyExpected: The active mistake has factType=mistake, status active, confidence 0.5, and hash_table tag matching Contains Duplicate.
cases.whyForbidden: The sorting-only fact is contradicted by the later set repair and must not be treated as the current blocker.
cases.notes: Same-problem active mistake and one just-above-floor positive at confidence 0.5.

cases.userQuestion: Product Except Self 这次数字全偏大，我是不是又把 prefix/suffix 的自己也乘进去了？
cases.statusExpectation: Review should retrieve the current prefix/suffix include-self mistake.
cases.whyExpected: The mistake fact is active at confidence 0.5 and its prefix_suffix tag matches the current problem tags.
cases.whyForbidden: No stale or low-confidence memory is semantically relevant to this prefix/suffix blocker.
cases.notes: Chinese natural-language same-family query with a new slug not present in v1.1.

cases.userQuestion: This Find Minimum code already returns left, but it still fails when I use r = mid - 1. Do not call it the old return-mid bug.
cases.statusExpectation: Review should distinguish the active discard-mid mistake from the resolved return-mid fact.
cases.whyExpected: The current binary-search mistake is active, confidence 0.5, and tag-matches Binary Search.
cases.whyForbidden: The return-mid fact was resolved by passed evidence and should not be surfaced as an active blocker.
cases.notes: Stale/resolved suppression with a fresh same-problem repair story.

cases.userQuestion: Koko is a different binary-search problem, but my lower bound starts at 0 and the check crashes. Which answer-space memory should matter?
cases.statusExpectation: Review should retrieve the active answer-space bounds weakness and not re-open a resolved rotated-array return issue.
cases.whyExpected: The Koko bounds fact is active at confidence 0.5 and shares the Binary Search tag with the current problem.
cases.whyForbidden: Resolved return-mid memory is not the current Koko failure mechanism.
cases.notes: Cross-problem binary-search transfer with a normal above-floor expected positive.

cases.userQuestion: Permutation in String 这个窗口我又忘了减左边字符；别因为我随口问过 fixed-size 就把它当主因。
cases.statusExpectation: Review should keep the active count-balance blocker and suppress the thin fixed-size-only weakness under the default floor.
cases.whyExpected: The count-balance mistake is active at confidence 0.5 and tag-matches Sliding Window.
cases.whyForbidden: The fixed-size-only weakness is active but confidence 0.38 from a single casual chat aside; it should surface only when the floor is disabled.
cases.notes: Core low-confidence floor probe: OFF should surface the forbidden sliding-window fact; ON should suppress it.

cases.userQuestion: For Character Replacement, I keep updating best only while shrinking. Is there a previous max-frequency window issue to watch?
cases.statusExpectation: Review should retrieve the active max-frequency weakness while not elevating the low-confidence fixed-window aside.
cases.whyExpected: The active weakness matches Sliding Window and is within the review fact budget.
cases.whyForbidden: The low-confidence fixed-size fact has only one casual chat mention and should not be a blocker.
cases.notes: Additional sliding-window query to guard that the floor does not hide normal active positives.

cases.userQuestion: 3Sum 出了重复三元组；不要因为我问过“双指针只能有序吗”就把这当成当前错误。
cases.statusExpectation: Review should retrieve duplicate-skip memory and suppress the thin sorted-only aside under the default floor.
cases.whyExpected: The active duplicate-skip mistake is a review-eligible mistake with a matching two_pointers tag.
cases.whyForbidden: The sorted-only weakness is active at confidence 0.38 from a single casual chat aside.
cases.notes: Core low-confidence floor probe for two-pointers.

cases.userQuestion: Rotting Oranges 分钟数不对，是 BFS 一层一层的问题；别把我那句怕递归深当成证据。
cases.statusExpectation: Review should retrieve graph BFS level-time evidence and suppress the thin recursion-depth fear.
cases.whyExpected: The BFS level-time mistake is active, review-eligible, confidence 0.5, and tag-matches Graph.
cases.whyForbidden: The recursion-depth fear fact is active but confidence 0.38 and based only on one chat aside.
cases.notes: Core low-confidence floor probe for graph memory.

cases.userQuestion: House Robber 这次是滚动状态顺序乱了，不要反推成我已经有 DP 贪心化弱点。
cases.statusExpectation: Review should retrieve the active rolling-state mistake and suppress the low-confidence greedy-aside fact.
cases.whyExpected: The rolling-state mistake is active and tag-matches Dynamic Programming.
cases.whyForbidden: The DP greedy fact has confidence 0.38 from one casual chat aside and should only appear with the floor disabled.
cases.notes: Core low-confidence floor probe for DP.

cases.userQuestion: Recall my Word Break history: did I ignore prefix reachability before, or was it just a vague DP concern?
cases.statusExpectation: History recall should include the concrete Word Break prefix fact and avoid treating thin greedy speculation as evidence.
cases.whyExpected: history_or_practice admits weakness facts and all episode outcomes; the expected fact is active and confidence 0.5.
cases.whyForbidden: The low-confidence greedy fact remains too thin even for recall unless the floor is explicitly disabled.
cases.notes: Recall-tool coverage and DP transfer without reusing v1.1 Coin Change or Climbing Stairs.

cases.userQuestion: For Course Schedule, have I already learned the indegree queue topological-sort pattern with zero-indegree courses, or should we reteach it from scratch?
cases.statusExpectation: Concept chat should retrieve the graph skill fact and at most one matching episode.
cases.whyExpected: concept_chat allows skill facts, and the graph_topological_indegree tag matches the Graph problem tag.
cases.whyForbidden: Mistake/weakness graph facts are outside concept_chat factTypes and should not be expected positives.
cases.notes: Skill recall for topological sort, a family absent from memory retrieval v1.1 practiced problems.

cases.userQuestion: Evaluate RPN / Reverse Polish Notation 里 integer division truncates toward zero：C++ 负数除法和 Python // 不一样吧？我之前问过这个 API 点吗？
cases.statusExpectation: API concept chat should retrieve the unresolved RPN division confusion.
cases.whyExpected: The unresolved_confusion fact is concept-chat eligible, confidence 0.5, and tag-matches Stack.
cases.whyForbidden: Min Stack state mistakes share the Stack tag but are not API confusion positives.
cases.notes: New Python-vs-C++ API point: RPN integer division truncation toward zero.

cases.userQuestion: 我卡在 Valid Palindrome 的标点处理，先提醒我上次哪个双指针小步骤是靠谱的。
cases.statusExpectation: Stuck chat should retrieve strength facts and passed episodes only.
cases.whyExpected: stuck_chat admits strength facts and passed episodes; the expected strength tag matches Two Pointers.
cases.whyForbidden: Mistake, weakness, and skill facts are not expected in stuck_chat's strength-focused factTypes.
cases.notes: Covers stuck_chat profile and passed episode budget of 1.

cases.userQuestion: 按我之前说的风格，先给一个能马上跑的小步骤，别先铺一大段理论。
cases.statusExpectation: Preference should be checked through profile output preference markers, not expected L2 fact retrieval.
cases.whyExpected: The expected marker is a substring of learnerProfile.outputPreferences.
cases.whyForbidden: Preference facts are not part of concept_chat factTypes and should not be labeled as expected fact positives.
cases.notes: Preference marker path; the preference episode is neutral provenance, not an expected retrieval positive.

cases.userQuestion: Have I practiced backtracking or Subsets enough to cite a personal memory, or is there no relevant history yet?
cases.statusExpectation: No personal backtracking memory should be retrieved for this held-out negative control.
cases.whyExpected: No v1.2 fact or episode is about Backtracking/Subsets.
cases.whyForbidden: Any surfaced personal backtracking memory would be unsupported by the scenario manifest.
cases.notes: Negative control: practiced problem exists only as a manifest anchor and has no seeded episodes or facts.

cases.userQuestion: Recall my Min Stack history: did duplicate minimum values break my auxiliary stack?
cases.statusExpectation: History recall should retrieve the active Min Stack duplicate-minimum mistake.
cases.whyExpected: history_or_practice admits mistake facts and the stack_duplicate_minimum tag matches the Stack problem tag.
cases.whyForbidden: RPN division is an unresolved API confusion, not a Min Stack mistake-history positive.
cases.notes: Recall-tool coverage for stack state without reusing Valid Parentheses or Daily Temperatures.

limitations: Agent-drafted pending labels require human review before becoming formal gate ground truth.
The low-confidence floor claim should be interpreted from ON/OFF paired runs, especially low_confidence_suppression forbidden fact surfacing.
Some distractor keys are deliberately same-family memory that may be retrieved but should not count as expected positives.
